readme.text:
DeepSeek Harness 插件：**一键就地回退对话到任意更早的用户消息**。
同窗口内完成，不新建分支、不换窗口，可一并还原工作区文件——即完整的 Claude Code `/rewind` 语义。 [English](README.en.md) | 中文 [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-rewind-plugin) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-rewind-plugin) [](https://github.com/SiriLee/dsh-rewind/actions/workflows/ci.yml) 刻意聚焦、保持极简，只做一件事：**就地回退到任意远的用户消息**，还能**顺手还原改过的文件**。

- **就地消息回退**——目标消息及其之后的内容同时从**模型上下文**和**渲染对话**中撤回，目标消息文本自动回填输入框。始终在原会话内完成，不新建分支、不残留副本。
- **轻量备份还原**——对齐 Claude Code：追踪写类工具编辑过的文件，回退时一并还原，已跟踪文件的外部变更也能还原。**局部追踪、写前备份、不变不存**，不依赖 git。
- **安全保障**——会话日志仅追加回退标记，从不删改；文件备份与还原经安全加固；**完备测试**，随 DSH 升级长期维护。安全模型：[docs/security-model.md](docs/security-model.md)。
每条用户消息的操作行都有一个 **↶ 回退** 按钮。点击后弹出模式选择浮层——「**仅回退对话**」或「**回退对话和文件**」，后者会先展示文件变更清单再确认。还可以通过 **`/rewind` 和 `/undo` 命令**便捷地选择和回退。

用户消息旁的 ↶ 回退按钮
模式选择浮层

「回退对话和文件」影响清单
/rewind 候选面板

**命令行**： ```sh dsh plugin --profile add dsh-rewind-plugin ``` **图形界面**：侧栏「插件」页 →「添加插件」→ 填 `dsh-rewind-plugin` → 安装 → 重启 DSH。
默认安装 `latest`，它适配 DSH 最新稳定版本。若使用的是旧版或内测版 DSH，请在 [Releases](https://github.com/SiriLee/dsh-rewind/releases) 页面找到适配的插件版本，并指定版本安装。 > [!WARNING] > npm 上的 `dsh-rewind` 属于其他作者，请用 `dsh-rewind-plugin` 安装。

1. 在对话中找到要回退的那条用户消息，或输入 `/rewind`（或其别名 `/undo`）打开候选列表选择。 2. **选中它。** 小浮层提供两种模式——「仅回退对话」或「回退对话和文件」。 3. 回退立即生效：对话回到目标消息当时的样子，目标消息的文本自动回填输入框——改完直接重发。 **键盘操作**：候选列表与模式浮层均支持 ↑↓ 移动、Enter 确认、Esc 取消/返回。
边界说明 - **回退内容完整保存**——被撤回的内容仍在日志中，可在「轨迹」面板查看；也可禁用插件让它们重新显示（仅界面）。 - **回退无法原地撤销**——但可以先禁用插件让被撤回的内容重新显示，再在回退前的位置上点「在新对话中分支」，新会话的上下文即可包含这些内容。 - **插话也能回退**——模型尚未读取的 `steering` 插话消息，同样可作为回退目标，不会打断当前生成。 - **回退已读消息会打断当前正在运行的回合**——确保回退的安全执行。

**快照备份**（默认开启）：用于文件还原；可在本插件的配置卡片中关闭。关闭后不再创建新的快照，关闭期间的文件改动无法还原。快照存储于 `/rewind-snapshots/`（默认 `~/.dsh/rewind-snapshots/`）。手动删除该目录仅清除文件备份，对话回退不受影响，插件可自动重建。 **快照自动清理**（默认关闭）：把长期不活跃的会话快照整目录移除，不影响活动会话与对话日志。可在配置卡片查看与配置（自动清理开关、失活天数），也可用 `/snapshot-auto-cleanup` 命令查看、设置和运行。详见：[快照自动清理](docs/snapshot-auto-cleanup.zh.md)。
```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-rewind-plugin

rm -rf <dsh home>/rewind-snapshots
rm <dsh home>/snapshot-cleanup-last-sweep.json
```

本插件的配置项保存在当前 Profile 的配置文件 `cordis.patch.yml` 中。如需彻底清理，可手动删除对应条目。

相较于默认行为，本插件带来的变化：

| 维度 | 默认行为 | 本插件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 对话回退 | 新建分支对话 | **就地回退**——不用新建会话分支、不切窗口，也不产生残留会话副本，回退更便捷 |
| 文件还原 | 手动还原 / Git 管理 | **一键还原**——写前轻量备份，回退对话时可选一并还原文件，贴合 Agent 工作流 |
| 还原依赖 | 常依赖 Git 仓库或完整快照引擎 | **无依赖**——不依赖 Git 仓库，也不要求是代码项目，普通目录即可用 |
整套设计只有两条主线，核心哲学朴素却克制：**对话部分「只遮蔽、不删除」**，使用 DSH 原生的「隐藏 + 替换」机制；**文件部分「局部追踪，写前轻量备份」**，参考 Claude Code 的检查点语义。

readme.section: 1. 对话回退：一次「遮蔽」，而不是「删除」
readme.text:
`append-only` 是铁律：会话日志只追加、从不改写——这是可审计与信息安全的地基。回退从不动历史，它只做一步：往日志末尾追加一条 **“空消息”标记**，把目标消息及其之后的全部内容「遮蔽 + 替换」掉，让模型和界面都只看得到目标之前的部分。

- **同一份日志**——只在当前会话的日志做简单追加，不新建会话、不新建分支，因此不会留下残留和副本；
- **标记是规范的**——采用与官方 `/compact` 相同的「隐藏 + 替换」：`/compact` 把一段历史压缩成摘要，`/rewind` 则换成一条“空消息”标记。由于其规范性，DSH 的日志重放、压缩、续接检查都能正确识别它，绝不会把它误认为真实对话；
- **替换内容无感**——模型对标记忽略、无感（实测验证）。配合插件对界面显示的处理，模型和你看到的对话就是目标消息当时的样子；
- **记录完整保留**——因为是「遮蔽」而非「删除」，被撤回的内容完整留在日志里，可审计、可追溯，原则上也能手动恢复。

readme.section: 1. 对话回退：一次「遮蔽」，而不是「删除」
readme.text: > **设计点睛**：整个对话回退就是**一条**追加。它确定、可审计，且因为日志从未被破坏，回溯是「干净的」——用最小的动作，实现最完整的语义。

readme.section: 2. 文件还原：轻量检查点，「写前备份」
readme.text: 文件部分对齐 Claude Code 的检查点语义——**局部追踪、写前备份 + 每条消息重扫已跟踪文件**，而不是整树快照。这项取舍省空间，也让已跟踪文件的外部改动同样可还原：

readme.section: 2. 文件还原：轻量检查点，「写前备份」
readme.text:
- **写前备份**：只追踪写类工具（`write`、`edit`），写前**备份原内容**，并**记录、追踪**被处理的文件——从不备份整个工作区，因此轻量；**单个文件过大时不备份**。
- **外部变更也追**：每条用户消息边界，插件重新检查所有已跟踪文件——命令执行、手动修改等外部变更同样被记录，回退时一并还原。这让「轻量」却不「残缺」。
- **不变不存**：记录只在有变化时发生——消息边界重扫时无变更的**不备份**（不留记录）；写前备份时若与前一条记录一致，只存指向它的链接（`ref`）而非复制内容。
- **还原准确**：以备份为唯一标准，对照真实磁盘，只动真正不一致的文件；备份逐字节存储。还原结果与备份一致，无“幽灵影响”。覆盖范围按设计限定：[文件回退的追踪边界](docs/compat/tracking-boundary.zh.md)。
- **安全与完整性**：路径经安全化处理，绝不越出备份根目录；符号/硬链接跳过，避免透过一次还原误伤同名的另一份文件；单个文件失败绝不中止整轮还原；备份与还原日志均原子写落盘（跨重启仍在），断电或崩溃后的半还原可续做或回滚。

readme.section: 2. 文件还原：轻量检查点，「写前备份」
readme.text: > **设计点睛**：这套检查点的「轻」，来自**只记录被工具动过、且确实变化的文件**——写前备份保证可还原，不变不存与存链接压掉重复；还原时再对照真实磁盘，只动不一致的文件。

本插件刻意保持轻量、聚焦「对话回退」这一件事，以下场景**不属于它的职责**，各自有更合适的归属（见[设计边界](docs/boundaries.zh.md)）：

- **整树 / Git 级快照**——只跟踪写类工具编辑 + 已跟踪文件的外部改动，从未被工具碰过的文件不还原。工作区历史（任意文件、任意时刻）归 Git；Agent 本来就在用 Git，插件不重复造这层。需要工作树级的完整快照回退时，请交给 Git 或项目自选的快照工具。
- **子代理的编辑**——不追踪，子代理会话内也不提供回退（同 Claude Code）：子代理运行在自己的会话里，其备份无法由父会话的回退还原，因此也不会为子会话保留备份。
- **fork / 分支回退**——DSH 已内置「在新对话中分支」功能，不重复造轮子。

- Node.js `>=24.9.0`。
- 支持的 DSH 版本由 `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 声明。
- 兼容性定义、验证方法与版本对齐详见 [docs/compat/audit.md](docs/compat/audit.md)。

> [!WARNING]
> 本项目与 DeepSeek Harness 均处于开发者预览阶段。可复现环境请 pin 精确版本，
> 并阅读上述行为说明。

1. **轮次导航保留已回退轮次**——右侧轮次导航为已回退轮次保留「未加载」刻度，悬浮可预览已撤回内容。仅显示差异，无功能影响。
2. **较远回退可能显示空白**——回退目标早于已加载的历史时，对话区会显示空白；需点击「加载更早」往前翻，才能看到历史对话。

> [!NOTE]
> 本插件提供浏览器端诊断输出；详见 [浏览器诊断](docs/compat/diagnostics.zh.md)。

本插件只向会话日志追加回退标记事件，从不删除或改写已记录的历史。工作区文件仅在「回退对话和文件」时被改写，备份存储于 `<dsh home>/rewind-snapshots/`；还原以备份为唯一来源。不触碰你的 git 仓库，无网络请求，不访问任何凭据。对**长期不活跃**的会话，另有默认关闭的快照自动清理可整目录移除其快照，不影响活动会话与对话日志。完整安全模型：[docs/security-model.md](docs/security-model.md)；漏洞报告政策见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

Conversation rewind for DeepSeek Harness: **rewind the conversation to any earlier user message in one click, in the same window**.
No new branch, no window switch, with optional workspace-file restore — the full Claude Code `/rewind` semantics. English | [中文](README.md) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-rewind-plugin) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-rewind-plugin) [](https://github.com/SiriLee/dsh-rewind/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
A deliberately focused plugin with one job: **rewind to any user message, no matter how far back, in place** — and conveniently **restore the files it changed** along the way.

- **In-place rewind, no new session** — the target message and everything after it (replies, tool calls) are withdrawn from the model context *and* the rendered transcript, and the target's text is filled back into the composer for editing and re-sending. It all happens inside the original session: no new branch, no leftover copy.
- **Conversation and files rewind together** — Claude Code-aligned behavior: files edited by the write tools are tracked and restored by the same rewind, and external changes to already-tracked files are restorable too. **Partial tracking, before-write backup, store only on change**, with no git dependency.
- **Safety guarantees** — the session log only ever appends rewind markers and is never deleted or rewritten; file backup and restore are hardened; tests are comprehensive, and maintenance continues across DSH upgrades. Security model: [docs/security-model.md](docs/security-model.md).

Every user message carries a **↶ rewind** button in its action row. Clicking it opens a mode-selection popover — "**rewind conversation only**" or "**rewind conversation and files**", the latter showing the file-change list for confirmation first. You can also pick and rewind conveniently via the **`/rewind` and `/undo` commands**.

Per-message ↶ rewind button
Mode-selection popover

"Conversation and files" impact list
/rewind candidate picker

**Command line**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile add dsh-rewind-plugin ``` **Graphical interface**: the **Plugins** page in the sidebar → **Add plugin** → enter `dsh-rewind-plugin` → install → restart DSH.

The default install is `latest`, which targets the latest stable DSH release. If you are on an older or alpha DSH version, find the matching plugin version on the [Releases](https://github.com/SiriLee/dsh-rewind/releases) page and install that version explicitly.

> [!WARNING]
> The npm name `dsh-rewind` belongs to another author's package — install with `dsh-rewind-plugin`.

1. Find the user message you want to rewind to in the conversation, or type `/rewind` (or its alias `/undo`) to open the candidate picker.
2. **Select it.** A small popover offers the two modes — "conversation only" or "conversation and files".
3. The rewind takes effect immediately: the conversation returns to how it looked at the target message, and the target message's text is filled back into the composer — edit and re-send.

**Keyboard**: both the candidate picker and the mode popover support ↑↓ to move, Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel/back.
Edge notes

- **The withdrawn content is preserved** — it stays in the session log and can be inspected in the **Trajectory** panel; you can also disable the plugin to show it again (display only).
- **A rewind cannot be undone in place** — to carry the content forward, first disable the plugin so the withdrawn content shows again, then click **Branch into a new conversation** on the message just before the rewind; the new conversation's context will include it.
- **Interruptions rewind too** — a `steering` message the model hasn't read yet is also a valid rewind target, and withdrawing it does not interrupt the current run.
- **Rewinding a read message interrupts the running turn** — to ensure the rewind runs safely.
</details>

**Snapshot backups** are on by default: they power file restore and can be
switched off in this plugin's configuration card. When off, no new snapshots
are created; file changes made while off cannot be restored. Snapshots (the
before-write backups) are stored under `<dsh home>/rewind-snapshots/`
(the default is `~/.dsh/rewind-snapshots/`).
**Deleting that directory manually** only clears the file backups (chat rewinds are
unaffected); the plugin can rebuild that directory automatically.

A **snapshot auto-cleanup** (off by default) removes the snapshot directories of
long-inactive sessions, leaving the active session and chat log untouched. Configure
and review it on the **Plugins** page, in this plugin's configuration card (the
auto-cleanup switch and the idle-day cutoff), or use the
`/snapshot-auto-cleanup` command to **view, configure, and run** it. See:
[Snapshot auto-cleanup](docs/snapshot-auto-cleanup.md).
```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-rewind-plugin

rm -rf <dsh home>/rewind-snapshots
rm <dsh home>/snapshot-cleanup-last-sweep.json
```

The plugin's configuration entries are stored in the current Profile's config
file `cordis.patch.yml`. To clean up completely, delete the corresponding entries
manually.

| Dimension | Default behavior | This plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Conversation rewind | Branch into a new conversation | **In-place rewind** — no new session branch, no window switch, no leftover session copies, and rewinding is more convenient |
| File restore | Manual restore / Git management | **One-click restore** — lightweight before-write backups; optionally restore files together with the conversation, fitting agent workflows |
| Restore dependencies | Often needs a Git repository or a full snapshot engine | **None** — no Git repository and no code project required; works in any directory |

The whole design rests on two principles, simple but deliberate: **the conversation half "masks, never deletes"**, using DSH's native "hide + replace" mechanism; **the file half "partial tracking, lightweight before-write backup"**, following Claude Code's checkpoint semantics.

readme.section: 1. Conversation rewind: a single "mask", not a delete
readme.text: `append-only` is a hard rule: the session log only grows and is never rewritten — the foundation of auditability and privacy. A rewind never touches history; it makes a single move: append **one "empty message" marker** to the end of the log and use it to "mask + replace" the target message and everything after it, so the model and the UI see only what came before it.

readme.section: 1. Conversation rewind: a single "mask", not a delete
1. Conversation rewind: a single "mask", not a delete
readme.text: > **Design highlight**: the entire conversation rewind is **a single append**. It's deterministic, auditable, and — because the log was never broken — a "clean" time-travel. Minimal action, complete semantics.

The file half follows Claude Code's checkpoint semantics — **partial tracking + before-write backup, plus a re-scan of tracked files at each message**, not a whole-tree snapshot. This trade-off saves space while still covering external changes to tracked files:

- **Before-write backup**: tracks only the write-class tools (`write`, `edit`) — backs up the original content before a write and records/tracks the files it touches; it never backs up the whole workspace, so it's lightweight; **a single file that is too large is not backed up**.
- **External changes count too**: at every user-message boundary the plugin re-checks all tracked files — external changes such as a command run or a manual edit are recorded as well and restored by a later rewind. "Lightweight" but not "incomplete".
- **Unchanged-not-recorded**: an entry is written only when something changed — at the message-boundary re-check, an unchanged file is never backed up (no record); at before-write time, when the new content matches the path's prior record, only a **link to it** (`ref`) is stored instead of a copy.
- **Accurate restore**: backups are the sole standard, checked against the real disk — **only files that actually differ are touched**. Backups are stored byte for byte, so the restored result matches the backups exactly, with no "ghost impact". Coverage is bounded by design: [File-rewind tracking boundary](docs/compat/tracking-boundary.md).
- **Safety and integrity*

> **Design highlight**: this checkpoint's light footprint comes from **recording only what was actually touched and really changed** — before-write backup makes it restorable, unchanged-not-recorded and content-as-link drop the repetition; only the files that differ are touched at restore time.

This plugin deliberately stays lightweight and focused on one thing — "conversation rewind". The following are **out of its scope**, and each has a better owner (see [design boundaries](docs/boundaries.md)):

- **Whole-tree / Git-level snapshots** — only write-class tool edits plus external changes to already-tracked files are backed up; files never touched by a tool are not restored. Workspace history — any file, any moment — belongs to Git; the agent already uses it, and the plugin does not rebuild that layer. For a worktree-level full snapshot rollback, use Git or the snapshot tool the project already uses.
- **Subagent edits** — not tracked, and no rewind inside a subagent session (same as Claude Code): a subagent runs its own session, so its backups could never be restored by a rewind of the parent session, and none are kept for one.
- **Fork / branch rewind** — DSH already provides this ("branch in new chat"); no need to reinvent the wheel.

- Node.js `>=24.9.0`.
- Supported DSH versions are declared by `package.json` `engines.dsh`.
- Compatibility definition, verification method, and version alignment: see [docs/compat/audit.md](docs/compat/audit.md).

> [!WARNING]
> This project and DeepSeek Harness are both in developer preview. Pin exact

1. **Turn navigation keeps rewound turns** — the right-side turn navigation keeps an "unloaded" tick for each rewound turn, and hovering previews the withdrawn content. Only a display difference; no functional impact.
2. **A far rewind may show a blank transcript** — when the target predates the loaded history, the conversation area goes blank; click **Load earlier** to page back until the history appears.

> [!NOTE]
> Browser diagnostics are available; see [Browser diagnostics](docs/compat/diagnostics.md).

This plugin only appends rewind-marker events to the session log; it never deletes or rewrites logged history. Workspace files are written only when you choose "conversation and files"; backups are stored under `<dsh home>/rewind-snapshots/`; restores draw only from those backups. It never touches your git repository, makes no network requests, and accesses no credentials. For sessions you've left inactive for a long time, a snapshot auto-cleanup (off by default) can remove their snapshot directory in whole, leaving the active session and the chat log untouched. Full security model: [docs/security-model.md](docs/security-model.md); to report a vulnerability, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
